consistencyRules.message: Class 1a applies only to class 1 (completely seizure free, no auras).

commonErrors: Counting seizures rather than seizure days.
Counting seizures from the first postoperative month.
Reporting one class for the whole follow-up instead of per year.
name: ILAE Epilepsy Surgery Outcome Classification

version.label: ILAE outcome classification (Wieser et al. 2001), classes 1–6 with 1a
version.detail: Assessed for each year after surgery, on each anniversary. A seizure day is a 24-hour period with one or more seizures. Baseline is seizure days in the 12 months before surgery. Seizures in the first postoperative month are not counted. Class 1a: completely seizure free since surgery, no auras.

purpose: Classifies seizure outcome after epilepsy surgery for each year of follow-up, using seizure days relative to baseline.
intendedPopulation: Patients after epilepsy surgery with documented pre-operative seizure frequency.

calculatorNotice.title: One class per follow-up year
calculatorNotice.message: Classify each year after surgery separately. Count seizure days, not seizures, and ignore the first postoperative month.

options.label: Class 1: Completely seizure free; no auras
Class 2: Only auras; no other seizures
Class 3: One to three seizure days per year, with or without auras
Class 4: Four seizure days per year to a 50% reduction of baseline seizure days, with or without auras
Class 5: Less than a 50% reduction of baseline seizure days to a 100% increase, with or without auras
Class 6: More than a 100% increase of baseline seizure days, with or without auras

inputDefinitions.label: Seizure free with no auras since surgery? (class 1a)

calculationMethod.share: ILAE outcome class {is1a == 1 ? '1a' : total}{isnull(fu) ? '' : ', year ' + fu}

resultStates.label: Class 1a
resultStates.summary: Completely seizure free since surgery, with no auras, at this assessment.
resultStates.detail: Outcome is classified year by year and can change; report the follow-up year.

resultStates.label: Class 1
resultStates.summary: Completely seizure free with no auras in this follow-up year, at this assessment.
resultStates.detail: Outcome is classified year by year and can change; report the follow-up year.

resultStates.label: Class 2
resultStates.summary: Only auras, no other seizures, in this follow-up year, at this assessment.
resultStates.detail: Auras count only if brief, not observable by others and similar to pre-operative auras.

resultStates.label: Class 3
resultStates.summary: One to three seizure days per year, with or without auras.

resultStates.label: Class 4
resultStates.summary: Four seizure days per year to a 50% reduction of baseline seizure days, with or without auras.

resultStates.label: Class 5
resultStates.summary: Less than a 50% reduction of baseline seizure days to a 100% increase, with or without auras.
resultStates.detail: Assess seizure type, frequency and medication according to the clinical situation; the class depends on the baseline seizure-day frequency.

resultStates.label: Class 6
resultStates.summary: More than a 100% increase of baseline seizure days, with or without auras.
resultStates.detail: Assess seizure type, frequency and medication according to the clinical situation; the class depends on the baseline seizure-day frequency.

clinicalContext.text: Defines outcome by seizure days relative to the pre-operative baseline, year by year.
Designed to be less subjective than the Engel classification.

clinicalInsights.text: Classes 4–6 depend on the baseline seizure-day frequency; record the baseline used.
Auras count only if brief, not observable by others and similar to pre-operative auras.

limitations.text: Requires a documented 12-month pre-operative baseline; approximations must be stated.

limitations: Does not capture seizure severity, quality of life or medication changes.
A patient's class can change from year to year.

confounders.effect: Can provoke seizures in a given year.

whatItDoesNotTellYou: Quality of life or cognitive outcome.

guideSections.what: Six outcome classes after epilepsy surgery (1–6, with 1a) based on seizure days per year relative to baseline.
guideSections.whenToUse: Reporting year-by-year seizure outcome after epilepsy surgery, often alongside Engel.
guideSections.howToPerform: For the follow-up year assessed, count seizure days (excluding the first postoperative month) and auras. Compare with the baseline seizure days in the 12 months before surgery. Choose the class; mark 1a if seizure free with no auras since surgery.
guideSections.clinicalContext: An outcome classification; consider quality of life, cognition and medication alongside it.

sources.citation: Wieser HG, Blume WT, Fish D, et al. ILAE Commission Report. Proposal for a new classification of outcome with respect to epileptic seizures following epilepsy surgery. Epilepsia. 2001;42(2):282-286.
